text: On Valentine's Day 1900, the girls of Appleyard College picnic beneath Hanging Rock, where [both watches stop at noon|rules|reality comes apart]. Miranda, Marion and Irma climb the Rock, fall asleep, and walk in a trance into [a crevice in the stone|threat|evil places] while one of their teachers runs after them. Only Irma is found, with no memory. As scandal empties the school, the orphan Sara is [punished because no one pays her fees|who_suffers|young children], and the vanished [are never explained|ending|the ending is left open].
